// MOCK: Scaffold only: this file is not compiled into the app and contacts no service. It shows no ad and grants a reward only to the closure you pass.

final class MockRewardedAdService: AdService {
    static let isMock = true
    var isMock: Bool { Self.isMock }
    private let placements: [AdPlacement]
    private let log: (String) -> Void
    private var shownCount: [String: Int] = [:]
    private var lastShown: [String: Int] = [:]

    init(placements: [AdPlacement] = AdPlacements.all, log: @escaping (String) -> Void = { print($0) }) {
        self.placements = placements
        self.log = log
    }

    func canShow(_ placementId: String, _ nowSeconds: Int) -> Bool {
        guard let p = placements.first(where: { $0.id == placementId }) else { return false }
        return FrequencyLimit.canShow(p.minSecondsBetween, p.maxPerSession, shownCount[placementId] ?? 0, lastShown[placementId] ?? -1, nowSeconds)
    }

    func show(_ placementId: String, _ nowSeconds: Int, onReward: (_ rewardKind: String, _ rewardAmount: Int) -> Void) -> Bool {
        guard let p = placements.first(where: { $0.id == placementId }) else { return false }
        if !canShow(placementId, nowSeconds) { log("[MOCK AD] " + placementId + " skipped by frequency limit"); return false }
        shownCount[placementId, default: 0] += 1
        lastShown[placementId] = nowSeconds
        log("[MOCK AD] " + placementId + " simulated, no ad was shown")
        if p.type == "rewarded" { onReward(p.rewardKind, p.rewardAmount) }
        return true
    }
}
